run_scan_set_verbose: run the main scanner to find all hardcoded litellm.set_verbose = True assignments in the codebase
find_set_verbose_in_file: find all litellm.set_verbose = True assignments in a single Python file using AST parsing
scan_directory_for_violations: scan the litellm and enterprise directories for hardcoded set_verbose violations across all Python files
test_no_hardcoded_set_verbose: run the pytest test that fails if any hardcoded litellm.set_verbose = True assignments are found
review_set_verbose_usage: review the codebase to identify and report all prohibited hardcoded set_verbose assignments with line numbers
